tickets.problem: Provide the concrete development reference environment required for platform character rules before the complete library is ready.

deliverables: Reuse the pinned source recipe and configure the ubuntu-24.04 native runner to build and execute official Boost 1.89.0 with ICU4C 77.1.

tickets.problem: The B39/B40 byte POSIX path does not discharge the native-wide public behavior required by the complete compatibility inventory.
tickets.current_state: No native-wide POSIX equivalent has been implemented. This is a safe Rust interface, not a requirement to copy the C ABI.
deliverables: Map the actual wide POSIX reference trait selection, syntax/execute flags, bounded pattern/input/capture ranges and compile-status/error functions into the native-wide API.
Preserve original native-wide units, REG_PEND/STARTEND-style bounds where applicable, capture limits and source-defined no-sub behavior.
acceptance: Official native-wide POSIX fixtures compare compile status, numeric categories, flags, complete bounded captures and original-unit positions on Windows and Unix baselines.
Wide and byte modes use the source-selected character-rule backend; documentation/source conflicts are recorded with exact source evidence under ADR-0001.
No C ABI, MFC object model or C++ runtime backend is introduced solely to imitate host-language surface syntax.
